description: Pre-Carbon static HTML site (Claude Design export) with a tabbed layout (Customer journey / Order flow / Design Patterns / Sitemap / Design-to-Code). Kept as a structural and content reference only. Its markup uses raw <button> elements and hardcoded hex colors and is NOT Carbon-compliant — validate_page will flag both. Do not copy its markup or styling directly; use it only for layout/content inspiration, and rebuild any reused structure with Carbon components and tokens.
